description: This plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the accuracy of different methods across a varying number of demonstrations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick marks regularly spaced at intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and employs a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 5, specifically shown at 45, 50, and 55. The "Squared-Exponential" line is depicted as a dark blue solid line with circular markers; it begins at an accuracy of approximately 53 near 25 demonstrations, rises to about 56 at 250 demonstrations, and maintains a steady trend to end at roughly 56.5 at 1500 demonstrations. The "Tanh" line is shown as a medium blue solid line with circular markers, starting near an accuracy of 48 at 25 demonstrations and remaining relatively flat across the x-axis to end at approximately 48 at 1500 demonstrations. The "ELU" line is represented by a light blue solid line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 46.5 near 25 demonstrations and exhibiting a steady trend throughout to end at roughly 46.5 at 1500 demonstrations. Finally, the "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is a pink dash-dot line without markers that remains constant at an accuracy value of approximately 43 across the entire range of the x-axis.
